description_en: Invokes the DescribeEcGrantRelation operation to query the authorization relationship of a VPC-connected instance to a VBR instance in a cross-account VBR uplink scenario
description_zh: 调用DescribeEcGrantRelation接口查询跨账号创建VBR上连场景下VPC实例对VBR实例的授权关系
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ec-grant-relation --instance-type VBR --instance-id vbr-bp12mw1f8k3jgygk90000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEcGrantRelation

parameters.help_en:
The type of instance for which you want to query authorization relationships. Valid values:

VBR: Virtual Border Router (VBR) instance. Queries the VPC-connected instances that have granted authorization to the VBR instance.
VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC) instance. Queries the VBR instances to which the VPC-connected instance has granted authorization
parameters.help_zh:
要查询授权关系的实例类型。取值：

VBR：边界路由器VBR（Virtual border router）实例，表示查询VBR实例拥有哪些VPC实例的授权。
VPC：专有网络VPC（Virtual Private Cloud）实例，表示查询VPC实例对哪些VBR实例进行了授权
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the instance for which you want to query authorization relationships.

If InstanceType is set to VBR, set this parameter to the VBR instance ID.

If InstanceType is set to VPC, set this parameter to the VPC-connected instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询授权关系的实例ID。

当InstanceType取值为VBR时，此处配置为VBR实例ID。

当InstanceType取值为VPC时，此处配置为VPC实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VBR instance for which you want to query authorization relationships.

If InstanceType is set to VBR, this parameter is required.

If InstanceType is set to VPC, this parameter is not required
parameters.help_zh:
要查询授权关系的VBR实例所在地域ID。

当InstanceType为VBR时，该参数需要配置。

当InstanceType为VPC时，该参数不需要配置
parameters.name: vbr_region_no

EcGrantRelations.description_en: The list of authorization relationship query results
EcGrantRelations.description_zh: 查询授权关系的结果列表

items.description_en: The list of authorization relationship query results
items.description_zh: 查询授权关系的结果列表

AliUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the VPC instance owner in the authorization relationship
AliUid.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VPC所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the VPC-connected instance granted authorization to the VBR instance
GmtCreate.description_zh: VPC实例对VBR实例的授权时间

GrantType.description_en:
The scope of VBR instances that are granted authorization. Valid values:

All: The VPC-connected instance is authorized to all VBR instances under the specified region and Alibaba Cloud account.
Specify: The VPC-connected instance is authorized to a specified VBR instance
GrantType.description_zh:
接受授权的VBR实例的范围。取值：

All：将VPC实例授权给指定地域和阿里云账号（主账号）下的所有VBR实例。
Specify：将VPC实例授权给指定VBR实例

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance in the authorization relationship
InstanceId.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VPC实例ID

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the VPC instance in the authorization relationship
InstanceName.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VPC名称

InstanceRouterId.description_en: The vRouter ID of the VPC instance in the authorization relationship
InstanceRouterId.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VPC路由器ID

RegionNo.description_en: The region ID of the VPC instance in the authorization relationship
RegionNo.description_zh: 查询的授权关系VPC所在地域ID

Status.description_en:
The status of the authorization relationship. Valid values:

Created: An authorization relationship exists between the VPC-connected instance and the VBR instance.
Deleted: No authorization relationship exists between the VPC-connected instance and the VBR instance
Status.description_zh:
查询授权关系的结果。取值：

Created：VPC实例与VBR实例已有授权关系。
Deleted：VPC实例与VBR实例没有授权关系

VbrInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the VBR instance in the authorization relationship
VbrInstanceId.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VBR实例ID

VbrOwnerUid.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the VBR instance owner
VbrOwnerUid.description_zh: VBR实例所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

VbrRegionNo.description_en: The region ID of the VBR instance in the authorization relationship
VbrRegionNo.description_zh: 查询的授权关系的VBR实例所在地域ID

Page.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries in the list
